interpretation: Exploratory geometry counterfactuals. Variant names describe curve operations and do not imply an aesthetic ranking. P1 is the brow head and P5 the tail.

curve.order: P1 brow head to P5 brow tail
curve.warp: local inverse thin-plate spline with four fixed crop-corner anchors

shape_metrics.coordinate_definition: Per-eye mirrored frame: outward X starts at the inner eye corner; upward Y starts at the eye midpoint. Both are normalized by that eye's corner-to-corner width.
shape_metrics.mask_definition: Effective area uses alpha sum; binary review area uses alpha >= 0.5.
